note: In 70 adults randomized 35 per group, the thyme-containing combined product plus usual rhinosinusitis care showed an olfactory threshold score of 6.3 versus 6.1 (reported p ≤ .01) and an olfactory index of 0.5 versus 0.3 (p ≤ .05). At three weeks, olfactory disturbance was reported in zero adjunct participants and three controls. The comparison concerns the combined product. The study excludes neurodegenerative disease and does not isolate fresh thyme.
